##### Project general facts

Aura by Grovy Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential project located in District 11, JVC, offering a refined collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The architecture reflects a modern design approach with clean lines, balanced proportions, and energy-efficient façade glazing that enhances both aesthetics and sustainability. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space, natural light, and views, creating bright and comfortable living environments that embody modern urban living.

The development offers a lifestyle focused on comfort, convenience, and everyday functionality within a well-connected community. Residents benefit from a calm and visually appealing environment, where open views and a thoughtfully designed setting create a relaxing atmosphere. The project is designed to support modern living with integrated smart systems and practical features that enhance daily comfort and efficiency.

Inside, Aura features high-quality modern finishes with attention to detail across every space. Interiors are completed with branded anti-slip ceramic tiles, elegant wall finishes, and premium sanitary ware, complemented by walk-in showers and contemporary fittings. Home automation systems allow control of cooling and lighting, adding convenience and efficiency. Kitchens are fully fitted with wall and base cabinets, composite stone worktops, integrated appliances, and ambient lighting, while bedrooms include built-in wardrobes and integrated linear lighting. The residences are delivered unfurnished, offering a clean, modern foundation for personalisation.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
